name: Poor Old Woman
text: Poor Old Woman is the English rendering of the Irish names Sean-bhean Bhocht and Shan Van Vocht. All three titles personify Ireland herself. The figure stands for the country in song and story. The Shan Van Vocht node keeps its own record.
